title: Therapy: breathing sessions and the gag reflex
summary: Gil explains the body-based therapy he took, including breathing exercises and the gag reflex that releases pent-up anger.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: No I haven't. I went to a therapist but he didn't analysis in the same, intellectually. He didn't believe in, he thought it was a waste of time to analyse dreams, and It was a waste of time to find out who and where, when and how you were

first brutalized into this condition of so-called civilization. He thought that you would get more out of it, physically so ( I would go and we would have breathing sessions. He pressed me all over like this while I breathed. Maybe I, you know, slow breathing like that lying on the couch. And he would say, breathe a hundred and fifty or two hundred times. By that time you usually have some kind of a break through. You start laughing or crying.

Then there's a thing called the gag reflex which is something that's really not too well known. But it's a fantastic therapy, a medicine. It's not easy to do and hardly anyone knows about it, but the gag reflex is an automatic gagging. The word gag is wrong because you don't gag when the gag reflex occurs. It's an involuntary free release from your waist, from your groin right out through your mouth.

So when you do it, it's right before you have a meal so there's nothing in your stomach and you by-pass that totally. So when you exhale you go .....ah.... And when you do that and especially when you first do it, the first few months when you do it, the anger that you have pinned down there you know,
ever since when, all of a sudden it roars out of you you know. And you feel a direct opening in the gag reflex. It's a pleasurable feeling which accompanies it.

It was discovered accidentally in a clinic. A men was doing clinical work for thirty years and a man came in one day/he started unloading this enger, this way. He started....ah... and he got so healthy right after the session and he got so cured from it temporarily until it built up again, that the man began to look into it, to find out if it was a natural medical thing to do.

And it's hard to do because you live in a culture where you've got people around you and you're afraid, like if you take a breath and you go like that because you know that when it comes free, at first if it doesn't come free you will gag, you go ....ah.... and it stops.

But if it doesn't stop and it goes ...ah.... you will make a scream and you think all the neighbors will come and they'll call the police. So you've got all this paranoia naturally, so it's hard to do, you know. But if you can do that it helps. So that was part of my therapy, long xfxex answer to the question you asked. That was the therapy I took.
